browser_matrix: Firefox 152 headless through the WebDriver Marionette protocol
Firefox with keyboard navigation, reduced motion, and forced-colors CSS contracts
manual_review_method: Review the rendered wide and narrow states, keyboard sequence, browser-derived names and regions, focus return, and non-color status text. The recorded result is invalidated if the journey state or capture mapping changes.

keyboard_path: Tab to the visible skip control and activate it
Continue through current-work and readiness links without a pointer
Use the primary navigation to open delivery setup
focus_contract: Skip activation focuses the page heading
Route navigation focuses the destination heading
Refreshing repository facts preserves the refresh control
semantics: One page heading and a labelled main region
Primary and breadcrumb navigation have distinct names
Readiness states include text and symbols, not color alone
layout_review: The briefing and current work wrap without page-level horizontal scrolling
Long project and story identifiers remain inspectable
journeys.live_update_contract: Repeated repository facts do not create repeated live announcements.

manual_review.wide: pass — hierarchy, next action, and technical disclosure remain distinct
manual_review.narrow: pass — header navigation scrolls locally and the page does not scroll sideways
manual_review.assistive: pass — page, navigation, readiness, and current-work names are available in reading order
